vol_wall_thickness — 3D probe op

• 資料種類:voxel → signal

• 呼叫:import volprobe; volprobe.vol_wall_thickness(vol, p0, p1, sigma=1.0, threshold=0.1, spacing=None)(或 ops3d.get("vol_wall_thickness"))
